title: Hinoki Steam
premise: A decades-spanning drama at a mountain hot-spring inn. Xiaoyou and Ali are easily confused; the hinoki bath tub goes intact→cracked→hoop-repaired; the guest carriage is wrecked and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_keeper: Hot-spring innkeeper Afu around fifty, salt-and-pepper short beard, deep-blue yukata under a short jacket, copper key ring at the waist, warm solid smile.
states.scalded_with_cane: The same keeper after a scald: right calf bandage seeping, limping on a bamboo cane, short-jacket cuff scorched.
states.deceased: Afu has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the corridor tatami, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_apprentice: Young Xiaoyou: a lean girl attendant of fourteen or fifteen, vermilion hair ribbon, pale-cyan yukata, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Xiaoyou: a steady young woman keeper in her twenties, still in vermilion hair ribbon, yukata swapped for a deep-blue short jacket.

states.intact: A man-tall round hinoki bath tub, fine wood grain, brass hoops, inn family crest carved on the rim.
states.cracked_leaking: The same hinoki bath tub with a crack in the wall, brass hoop loose, hot water seeping along the seam.
states.hoop_repaired: The tub crack packed with new wood wedges, brass hoop retightened, crest still there, ready to hold water again.

states.intact: A lacquer-black guest-account water board with neat white chalk writing, hung on the office wall.
states.steam_blurred: The same water board blurred by hot-spring steam, writing bled, lacquer blistered.

states.intact: A deep-red two-wheel carriage, striped cushions in the cabin, inn family crest painted on the door, a gentle shaft horse.
states.overturned_wrecked: The deep-red carriage overturned into a creek ditch, shafts snapped, cushions soaked—a wreck that can no longer be driven.

states.young_rival: Ali, nearly identical in face to young Xiaoyou, dark-green hair ribbon, bold expression, a yew wood hairpin under the ear.
states.adult_rival: Adult Ali still in dark-green hair ribbon and yew wood hairpin under the ear, expression deeper.

E7.name: open-air bath
E7.appearance: An open-air bath on the mountainside, steam rising, pool rim lined with blue stone, cedar forest and night lamps in the distance.

E8.name: office corridor
E8.appearance: The inn's office corridor, tatami and low tables, guest-account water board on the wall, paper lanterns dim yellow.

E9.name: mountain-gate town street
E9.appearance: A machiya street under the mountain gate, wooden lattice windows and noren curtains, stone pavement wet with rain.

E10.name: abandoned bathhouse
E10.appearance: A half-collapsed abandoned bathhouse, blackened beams, cracked dry pool floor, weeds through the stone seams.

E11.name: keeper's brass plaque
E11.appearance: A brass plaque nailed to the inn lintel, engraved with Afu's name and year, edges verdigrised.

E12.name: yukata wood clips
E12.appearance: Three yukata wood clips hung on a bamboo pole in the corridor, clip heads lacquered with different color dots.

E13.name: rented rickshaw
E13.appearance: A rented black-hood rickshaw with no inn crest and no striped cushions, carrying only luggage.

E14.name: hot-spring guild chief
E14.appearance: A lean hot-spring guild chief in a deep-blue uniform haori and wide-brim hat, build close to Afu's, guild crest embroidered on the cuff.

E15.name: washi lanterns
E15.appearance: A row of five washi lanterns hung on stone lamp posts by the bath, bamboo frames, inn crest painted on the paper.

E16.name: bath-opening brass bells
E16.appearance: Two bath-opening brass bells hung under the office eaves, tongues tied with vermilion cord, ringing softly when the bath opens.

E17.name: yuzu-candy girl
E17.appearance: A girl selling yuzu candy on the machiya street, light-brown hair ribbon, gray yukata; at a glance like young Xiaoyou, shy gaze.

E18.name: plastic toy tub
E18.appearance: A half-man-tall plastic toy bath tub shaped like a hinoki tub, but no crest, hoops of tin.

E19.name: strange blue-canopy carriage
E19.appearance: A strange blue-canopy carriage, narrower cabin, no inn crest—not the deep-red guest carriage.

features.E2: Xiaoyou: vermilion hair ribbon, pale-cyan yukata, calm stubborn eyes.
features.E6: Ali: face nearly identical to Xiaoyou, but dark-green hair ribbon, yew wood hairpin under the ear, bold expression.

lookalike_pairs.note: Confuse: Xiaoyou and Ali distinguished by ribbon and hairpin.

scenes.setting: Open-air bath at dusk (five lanterns · two brass bells)
actions: At dusk, Afu steps across wet blue stone into the open-air bath and tests the water.

actions.action: A row of five washi lanterns hangs on the bath stone lamp posts; Afu lights them one by one.
Under the office corridor eaves hang two bath-opening brass bells; Afu reaches out and lets them ring softly.

actions: Afu checks whether the brass hoops of the hinoki bath tub have loosened.
Through the bath steam, Afu looks toward the cedar-forest night lamps.

actions.action: The hinoki bath tub fills with spring water; the wood grain shines in the lantern light.

actions: Afu sits on the blue-stone rim and listens to the creek.
In the office corridor Afu opens a chalk box and writes room numbers on the guest-account water board.
Afu sketches tonight's bath open hours in a blank corner of the water board.
Afu claps chalk dust from his hands and steps back to study the water board.

actions.action: A paper lantern in the corridor sways; wood-grain gleam from the hinoki bath tub sweeps Afu's profile.

scenes.setting: Corridor meets the apprentice (three yukata wood clips)
actions: In the morning office corridor, Afu greets young Xiaoyou driving the guest carriage in.

actions.action: Xiaoyou stops the deep-red carriage by the corridor stone steps and straightens the striped cushions.
Afu points to three yukata wood clips on the bamboo pole, teaching Xiaoyou to read color dots and room types.
Xiaoyou crouches in the corridor, curiously touching the tatami edge.
Afu explains to Xiaoyou the signals for opening and closing the bath.
Xiaoyou looks back at the intact guest carriage, eyes full of longing.

actions: Behind a noren on the mountain-gate town street, Ali in a dark-green hair ribbon turns to look.
Ali strides across the wet stone slabs, bold in expression.
Ali haggles with a shopkeeper; the yew wood hairpin under her ear sways slightly.
Ali carries a bamboo basket through the machiya street crowd.
In the office corridor, Xiaoyou and Ali stand side by side—one vermilion ribbon, one dark-green.
Xiaoyou hands Ali a wood clip; the two briefly lock eyes.
Ali straightens Xiaoyou's vermilion hair ribbon, then turns her face away.
They part at the stone steps, walking opposite ways.
Months later at night, Afu keeps watch alone in the corridor; the hinoki bath tub stands by the bath.

actions.action: Afu looks at the guest-account water board; hot-spring steam has blurred the writing on the lacquer.

actions: Afu wipes scale from the tub rim with a cloth.
Through a gap in the paper door, Afu gazes at the black cedar forest.

actions.action: The hinoki bath tub quietly steams in the night mist.

actions: In snow season, day after day Afu sweeps the bath blue stone.
Another rainy night, Afu checks the tub's brass hoops.
In peach-blossom season, Afu watches returning guests' lamps through the steam.
At midsummer noon, Afu wipes stone lamp posts heated by the sun.
Autumn leaves cover the corridor; Afu keeps watch alone until dawn.

scenes.setting: Corridor patrol (recall clips · strange blue-canopy carriage)
actions: At dawn, Afu patrols the office corridor; the guest carriage waits by the stone steps.

actions.action: Afu crouches to check the carriage shaft joints.
Afu walks to the bamboo pole; those three yukata wood clips still hang in place.
A strange blue-canopy carriage passes the mountain road—narrower cabin, not the deep-red guest carriage.
Afu stands on the stone steps, logging last night's spring-temperature swings.
Afu hangs yukata on the corridor bamboo pole.

scenes.setting: Spring surge disaster (tub cracks · carriage overturns)
actions: At midnight spring pressure spikes; the open-air bath boils; the hinoki bath tub shakes hard.
Hot steam swallows the stone lamp posts; lantern paper wrinkles.

actions.action: A sharp crack—the hinoki bath tub wall bursts, brass hoop loose and leaking.
On the mountain road, a startled horse drags the guest carriage into a creek ditch.
Shafts snap, cushions soak; the guest carriage becomes a wreck.
Afu lunges to the bath and steadies the cracked hinoki bath tub.
The next day, Afu stands by the bath, staring at the cracked leaking hinoki bath tub.
Afu brushes a fingertip along the tub-wall crack, face dark.
On an office wooden post Afu records the date the guest carriage overturned.
An old photo of the guest carriage still hangs on a corridor wall nail; Afu gazes a long time.
Afu takes one of the five washi lanterns from the stone lamp posts and sits alone by its faint light.
The damaged hinoki bath tub still stands by the pool; a gap shows beside the crest.

actions: Weeks later, Afu brings wood wedges and new brass hoops and begins repairing the hinoki bath tub.

actions.action: From the storehouse Afu takes a plastic toy tub shaped like a hinoki tub but without a crest.

actions: Afu carefully packs the crack and tightens the brass hoop.

actions.action: The hinoki bath tub no longer leaks; the crest is clear; it can hold spring water again.

actions: The repaired hinoki bath tub fills with hot water; Afu breathes out in relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: rickshaw and guild chief

actions.action: A black-hood rented rickshaw stops in the corridor, nothing like the long-wrecked guest carriage.
The hot-spring guild chief steps down and talks beside Afu; the two are similar in build.
The guild chief points at the rickshaw, explaining temporary guest pickup.
The rickshaw leaves; Afu alone in the corridor watches it go.
On the mountain-gate town street comes a yuzu-candy girl in a light-brown hair ribbon; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Xiaoyou.
The girl practices handing candy; Afu shakes his head—she is not Xiaoyou after all.
Years later at dusk, Afu with a seeping bandage on his right calf leans on a bamboo cane before the abandoned bathhouse.

actions: Afu looks up at the blackened beams, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two bath-opening brass bells under the bathhouse eaves ring softly in the wind; Afu pauses to listen.

actions: Afu lays a palm on the cold cracked pool floor, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: By day, adult Xiaoyou returns along the mountain road and hurries toward the abandoned bathhouse.

actions: By the cracked pool Xiaoyou reunites with cane-leaning Afu; the two embrace.

actions.action: Beside the corridor tatami, Xiaoyou holds Afu's gaunt hand.
Afu's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and passes away.
Afu's deep-blue short jacket still hangs behind the office door; Xiaoyou reaches out and gently strokes it.
By the inn lintel, adult Xiaoyou stands before the keeper's brass plaque.
Xiaoyou's fingertips brush Afu's name engraved on the brass plaque.
Adult Ali comes from the machiya street and locks eyes with Xiaoyou at the abandoned bathhouse.

actions: Xiaoyou and Ali stand side by side by the cracked pool—one calm-eyed, one deep in expression.
They look at each other without words, at faces alike yet different.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the youth straightening striped cushions in the corridor appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth straightening striped cushions in the corridor

actions.action: The opening moment returns—by the bath, a round wooden tub carved with a crest fills with hot water for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the round wooden tub first filled with hot water at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to that year's machiya street—a figure in a dark-green hair ribbon with a yew wood hairpin under the ear flashes by.

anchor.phrase: the figure in a dark-green hair ribbon on that year's machiya street

actions.action: Before the eyes again: that row of five old washi lanterns on the bath stone lamp posts.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old lanterns on the bath stone lamp posts

actions.action: Back to the dim yellow paper-lantern corridor of first meeting; the tatami is cool, as it always was.

anchor.phrase: the dim yellow paper-lantern corridor of first meeting

actions.action: Xiaoyou wipes that steam-blurred guest-account water board again and walks into the office corridor.
By the corridor bamboo pole, those three yukata wood clips still hang in place.
Xiaoyou takes over the hinoki bath tub; hot water fills the rim again.
